summary: Edits to agent prompts, instruction files, policies, skills and harness cards: facts re-derived by script, every cited path exists, adapters thin and in sync, no hard rule softened.

required_inputs.name: target_files
required_inputs.description: The instruction, prompt, policy, skill or card files to change

required_inputs.name: reason
required_inputs.description: The drift, incident or ruling that motivates the change

required_inputs.name: canonical_source
required_inputs.description: For a synced skill or card: the canonical location to edit

checklist.rule: Counts, versions and file names in prompts come from the facts script, never typed by hand
checklist.because: LINDA code-scout said 57 routers and 106 services when there were 59 and 120; six agents said Python 3.9 on a 3.12 repo

checklist.rule: Every path an agent prompt, spec or card cites exists on disk
checklist.because: Flex prompts cited src/middleware.ts and check-no-firstxi.mjs months after both were renamed; the agent-prompt-paths test now fails on that

checklist.rule: A synced skill or card is edited at its canonical source; a mirrored copy is never edited alone
checklist.because: War Room AGENTS.md: edit canonical sources in shared/, never generated copies; the sync overwrites mirrors

checklist.rule: Provider adapters stay thin shims of one role file; model and tool settings are preserved unless the change is about them
checklist.because: War Room's 2026-09-10 refresh collapsed stale role prompts; the instructions test checks adapter parity

checklist.rule: Where the repo says CLAUDE.md is a pointer, it stays exactly a pointer; policy lives in the files it points to
checklist.because: War Room CLAUDE.md is @AGENTS.md by design; duplicated policy drifts

checklist.rule: A hard rule (never, refuse, sensitive path) is never softened by a prompt edit; a change to one needs a recorded ruling
checklist.because: The sensitive-path rule and the external-effects rule are the load-bearing part of every harness; a helpful rewording has removed a never before

checklist.rule: A policy or card change validates against the schema and the family test
checklist.because: An invalid policy makes the guard hook deny every write; the validator exists for this

checklist.rule: Every checklist line in a card cites the incident or rule it comes from
checklist.because: A rule with no because is the first one a future editor deletes

checklist.rule: The done output names what could not be verified, for example a hook firing on a machine you do not have
checklist.because: The guard hook was pipe-tested in a container; only a Mac session proves it fires in Claude Code

done_output: paths checked: count and any missing
canonical source edited and which mirrors will refresh on sync
hard rules touched: none, or the ruling cited
stop_conditions: the change would soften a never without a ruling
the canonical source is unknown for a synced file
the change expands the managed-repos list
the facts script does not run

adapter_fields.name: adapter_dirs
adapter_fields.description: Provider adapter directories that must stay in parity

adapter_fields.name: facts_script
adapter_fields.description: The script that derives counts and versions

adapter_fields.name: instruction_test
adapter_fields.description: The test that checks instruction-file consistency

adapter_fields.name: spec_template_path
adapter_fields.description: The spec template spec-writer must emit, if the repo has one

adapter_fields.name: skill_sync_marker
adapter_fields.description: The marker file that lists synced skills
